title: Nashik Sports Klub
oneLiner: A race-safe booking platform for real sports inventory.
description: A booking platform for a sports club's Pickleball and Cricket courts, built with temporary slot holds, MongoDB transactions, live availability, secure sign-in, and an automated AWS deploy.
points: A 500-user concurrency test committed exactly one booking for the final slot.
Atomic transactions and compound indexes protect inventory under load.
Administrators, walk-in staff, and customers each get their own workflow.

title: Ask my portfolio
oneLiner: A portfolio you can ask questions, with the sources behind every answer.
description: The chat on this site. It answers questions about my work from hand-reviewed passages and shows which ones it used, how well each matched, and how long every step took.
points: Jev, the default retriever, reads passages as plain text and ranked the right source first more often than every embedding model I tried.
Questions the portfolio can't answer are refused before any language model is called.
Chunking, retrieval, and the answer model were each chosen by tests on locked question sets.

title: Real-time MERN Chat
oneLiner: Event-driven messaging with secure authentication and an AI assistant.
description: A real-time chat app with Socket.IO messaging, Google sign-in through Firebase, JWT-secured sessions, and a Gemini assistant.
points: Messages are delivered live through an event-driven Socket.IO layer.
Google OAuth, Firebase, and JWTs handle sign-in and sessions.
More than 100 users have sent over 500 messages on it.
